name: smwgraphics-gokujou-parodius-snes-traffic-signs-city
title: Gokujou Parodius (SNES) - Traffic Signs (City)
description:
A very colorful background seen in the fourth stage of Gokujou Parodius. It's a high speed stage where the player traverses a city.

Compared to the old version, palettes and gfx are much more optimized. Includes HDMA gradient seen in the original game, meant to be inserted with UberASM Tool.

There's two versions:
- City A: This one has two wide houses and two buildings named A1 and A2.
- City B: Has a lot of tall buildings and some construction sites.

Pick the one you like more. Cheers!
